name: Skulk Rock Clean-up
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
We Wildhammers remember the past, more than our brothers in Ironforge.  If you want to make friends here, then you get your hands dirty for us!

The Horde abandoned their positions in the Hinterlands around Skulk Rock; it's now overrun with nasty sludges and oozes.  We've got plans on that area, but first we need a clean-up crew to make a hole for us.

That's where you come in, Sunshine!  Head down there and take out ten green sludges and ten jade oozes, then report back to me here.  Move out!
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Green Sludges and 10 Jade Oozes, and then report back to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well look at you, helping out the Wildhammers!  You're a champion of action, and action is what we respect around here.

Your little clean-up mission is a lot more important than you might think it is.  With folks thinning out the oozes and sludges, we'll be able to extend our sphere of influence in no time. Here - have a little something in addition to just making new friends here in Aerie Peak!
narrative.requestItemsText: Make no effort to negotiate the mission at hand, friend!  If the gods had wanted those oozes killed, they would have miracled it done by now, wouldn't they?!
